# kapsel-diag golden `ks-r003`. Regenerate with KAPSEL_BLESS=1.
# file: -c
--- input
rm -rf $BUILD/
--- output
error[KS-R003]: `rm -rf` path begins with an unquoted expansion that may be empty
 --> -c:1:8
  |
1 | rm -rf $BUILD/
  |        ^^^^^^^
  |
  = note: with BUILD unset or empty this is `rm -rf /`
  = help: name the directory, or check and quote it: `test -n "$BUILD" && rm -rf "$BUILD"`

error: refused: 1 error
